description: This file defines a class `EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator` that implements the `MenuConfigurator` interface. Its purpose is to configure menu settings related to email subscription notifications in the OrangeHRM system, specifically overriding the current screen to 'viewEmailNotification'.

classes.name: OrangeHRM\Admin\Menu\EmailSubscriptionMenuConfigurator
classes.description: Implements menu configuration logic for email subscription features, overriding the screen to 'viewEmailNotification'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'viewEmailNotification' using a trait method, and returns null.
